notes: Chat now uses every current Gemini Flash model (3.5 to 3.8) and stops retrying retired or rate-limited models (gemini-2.5-flash had 101 failed attempts); a model picked in Settings that is no longer offered falls back to Automatic. The agent no longer stops when every model is busy mid-step, fetches model lists once per run, skips retired models, credits the model that really wrote the change, and marks steps that could not be done for attention instead of with a green check. The live feed keeps how a task started and gives every line the right icon. New: Actions → Check AI providers shows which models really answer.
